description: This PHP source file defines the OppFeed class, which extends FeedLogicBase, to handle feeding logic related to Opportunities in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It implements a method pushFeed that creates and pushes update feeds when an Opportunity is created or its sales stage changes to 'Closed Won'.

classes.name: OppFeed
classes.description: A class extending FeedLogicBase to handle Opportunity feed updates.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Generates and pushes a feed notification when an Opportunity is created or marked as 'Closed Won'.
